Maya (CSM): Heads-up: CobaltWorks dropped to ~28% active seat usage after their interim CTO paused API keys during a vendor security review. Renewal in ~5w. tagging for triage.

analytics-bot: Auto-report: CobaltWorks active_seats: 520 -> 145 (-72%), auth.errors: api.disabled_by_admin (3,210), recent spike 16:42 UTC. health: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/cobaltworks/health

Noah (AE): Procurement says AstraMind is in late-stage talks and offered a migration credit. Customer's champion moved to another company last week. We need fast remediation and a neutral comparison.

Priya (Customer Ops): New procurement contact is R. Vega. I'll intro Maya and schedule a 20m cleanup call. Also confirm if the admin pause was intentional audit or accidental.

Ivy (Solutions Eng): Quick ops unblock: can reprovision short-lived admin keys to get prod back while they finish the review. Internal command (ops only):
```
# reprovision admin key for org
redwoodctl keys create --org cobaltworks --scope admin --expires 48h --reason "security-audit-unblock"
```
Will also pull the audit log showing who issued the disable.

Maya (CSM): Proposed play: 1) immediate admin screen-share to reprovision and validate RBAC 2) offer a 10-day onboarding concierge (non-binding) to rehydrate seats 3) prepare a neutral feature/perf note vs AstraMind for procurement. Legal must review outreach copy before send.

Liam (Legal): Fine to offer non-binding concierge; do not promise Dedicated capacity, discounts, or SLA changes. Send proposed copy for review.

billing-bot: Note: any temporary keys and concierge hours are billable at standard rates. If team wants credits or a promotional trial, submit a billing-exception request.

Priya (Customer Ops): Scheduling call with R. Vega at 10:30am PT. Maya, Ivy, Noah: can you join?

Maya (CSM): Yes. Ivy please bring audit logs and a short RBAC checklist. Noah prepare procurement-friendly comparison bullets (no pricing). Action items assigned and watcher will monitor active_seats recovery.
